d: A security vulnerability has been detected in kekingcn kkFileView up to 5.0.3. This issue affects the function BaseUrlFilter.getBaseUrl of the file server/src/main/java/cn/keking/web/filter/BaseUrlFilter.java. The manipulation of the argument X-Base-Url leads to open redirect. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

t: JeecgBoot Table Dictionary API getTableDictList JimuFormApiService.getTableDictList sql injection
d: A weakness has been identified in JeecgBoot 3.9.5. This vulnerability affects the function JimuFormApiService.getTableDictList of the file /jeecg-boot/jmreport/form/getTableDictList of the component Table Dictionary API. Executing a manipulation of the argument searchSql can lead to sql injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A security flaw has been discovered in JeecgBoot 3.9.5. This affects an unknown part of the file /jeecg-boot/drag/onlDragDatasetHead/getAllChartData of the component JimuBI. Performing a manipulation of the argument params results in sql injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

t: floci-io Floci S3 Destination Configuration DeliveryStreamDescription.java S3Destination.bucketName path traversal
d: A vulnerability was identified in floci-io Floci up to 2.1.0. The affected element is the function S3Destination.bucketName of the file services/firehose/model/DeliveryStreamDescription.java of the component S3 Destination Configuration Handler. Such manipulation of the argument BucketARN leads to path traversal. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. Upgrading to version 2.2.0 is sufficient to fix this issue. The name of the patch is b986b95074ef524019be7af51e1df172e48faa4b. You should upgrade the affected component.

t: floci-io Floci Artifact CodeBuildJsonHandler.java BuildspecParser.parseArtifacts path traversal
d: A vulnerability was determined in floci-io Floci up to 2.4.0. Impacted is the function BuildspecParser.parseArtifacts of the file src/main/java/io/github/hectorvent/floci/services/codebuild/CodeBuildJsonHandler.java of the component Artifact Handler. This manipulation of the argument buildspecOverride.artifacts.base-directory causes path traversal. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

t: conductor-oss conductor PLANNER_CONTEXT_FETCH Task PlannerContextFetchTask.java WorkflowSystemTask.start server-side request forgery
d: A vulnerability was found in conductor-oss conductor up to 3.32.4/3.33.0/3.34.0-rc3/4.0.0-alpha.1. This issue affects the function WorkflowSystemTask.start of the file PlannerContextFetchTask.java of the component PLANNER_CONTEXT_FETCH Task Handler. The manipulation of the argument url results in server-side request forgery. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The researcher claims to have submitted a GHSA on the repository of the project.

t: Dianping CAT Report hourlyReport.tag Model.getDomain cross site scripting
d: A vulnerability has been found in Dianping CAT 3.0.0/3.1.0/4.0-RC1. This vulnerability affects the function Model.getDomain of the file WEB-INF/tags/hourlyReport.tag of the component Report Handler. The manipulation of the argument domain leads to cross site scripting. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

t: WordPress Frontend Admin by DynamiApps plugin <= 3.30.1 - Privilege Escalation vulnerability
d: Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in DynamiApps Frontend Admin by DynamiApps acf-frontend-form-element allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects Frontend Admin by DynamiApps: from n/a through 3.30.1.

A flaw has been found in Dianping CAT 3.0.0/3.1.0/4.0-RC1. This affects the function Handler.redirect of the file Handler.java of the component Login/Logout. Executing a manipulation of the argument rtnUrl can lead to open redirect. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

t: erupts erupt ReportService.java ReportService.queryBiData sql injection
d: A vulnerability was detected in erupts erupt up to 2.3.0. Affected by this issue is the function ReportService.queryBiData of the file ReportService.java. Performing a manipulation of the argument sort results in sql injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.4.0 can resolve this issue. The patch is named 8d2eaffc79b977c9d11222b9d435a002dceaa062. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component.

t: yungifez Skuul School Management System Delete GraduationController.php resetGraduation authorization
d: A security vulnerability has been detected in yungifez Skuul School Management System up to 2.6.3. Affected by this vulnerability is the function GraduationController::resetGraduation of the file app/Http/Controllers/GraduationController.php of the component Delete Handler. Such manipulation of the argument student leads to missing authorization. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. Upgrading to version 3.0.0 addresses this issue. The name of the patch is b42f2c80a8e5e01ca6e607bbd97f137ede368ac9. The affected component should be upgraded.

t: Tidelift moto AWS Batch Emulation models.py privileges management
d: A weakness has been identified in Tidelift moto up to 5.2.4. Affected is an unknown function of the file moto/batch/models.py of the component AWS Batch Emulation. This manipulation of the argument privileged/volumes causes improper privilege management. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

t: Fengoffice Feng Office File FilesController.class.php upload_document_image server-side request forgery
d: A security flaw has been discovered in Fengoffice Feng Office up to 3.11.13.11/4.2.1.2. This impacts the function upload_document_image of the file application/controllers/FilesController.class.php of the component File Handler. The manipulation of the argument url results in server-side request forgery. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

t: Fengoffice Feng Office Translation Tool ToolController.class.php write_translations code injection
d: A vulnerability was identified in Fengoffice Feng Office up to 3.11.13.11/4.2.1.2. This affects the function write_translations of the file application/controllers/ToolController.class.php of the component Translation Tool. The manipulation of the argument lang leads to code injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

t: Convene Azeus Convene Board Management Portal dummy_launcher.jsp cross site scripting
d: A vulnerability was determined in Convene Azeus Convene Board Management Portal 7.0.2.7_3 p72. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file /jsp/ge/dummy_launcher.jsp. Executing a manipulation of the argument REDIRECT_URL can lead to cross site scripting. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
